# Glossary — the ubiquitous language, generated

*Generated by `node tools/gen-glossary` from `spec/00` §0.2, `spec/03` AGSC-03-01, `spec/11` and `ontology/agsc.ttl`. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. Rules win over this page.*

## 1. Terms of the specification (spec/00 §0.2)

- **Bundle** — one directory tree of Markdown items plus exactly one `agsc.config.json`; the unit of publication and of conformance. *(AGSC-00-04)*
- **Item** — one `.md` file with YAML frontmatter whose `type` is one of `concept`, `episode`, `procedure`, `lesson`, `cluster`, `gate`. "Item" is a term of this specification only; no common superclass exists in the ontology (§05). A **published** item is one that is neither `draft` nor held back by the `releases` switchboard (AGSC-01-20); a **listed** item is a published item that is not `retired`. A retired item is published — it keeps its page, its per-item copies, its place in the graph exports (AGSC-11-22) and its resource on the local tool server (AGSC-09-14b) — and is not listed: it leaves `search.json`, `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, `/chunks.jsonl`, the skill packs, `agsc-counts`, the index pages that list items (a type's, a tag's, a cluster's members, the home page and the search page), every composition selection and what the page tools see (AGSC-09-16). A rule that names "the published set (AGSC-06-30)" means the listed set. The local tool server of AGSC-09-13 is not a published surface: it reads the author's own Bundle, draft and held-back items included. *(Amended 2026-10-02 for 1.0.0: "published" had these two extents and no definition.)* *(Amended 2026-10-06 for 1.0.0: the index pages are named among what a retired item leaves; until `1.0.0-rc.6` the reference engine also dropped its page, its per-item copies and its graph entry, against AGSC-11-22.)* *(Amended 2026-10-10 for 1.0.0: the lists of what a retired item keeps and leaves did not name the tool server's resources, `/llms-full.txt` or the page tools, and the local tool server, which reads drafts, was not set apart from the published surfaces)* *(AGSC-00-05)*
- **Concept** (with a `kind` qualifier), **Episode**, **Procedure**, **Lesson**, **Cluster**, **Gate** are the six item types. **Link**, **Source**, **Proposal**, **Review**, **Bundle**, **Harness** complete the ubiquitous language; Proposal and Review have no file (they are a forge pull request and its `verified[]` evidence), Source is an inline `sources[]` entry, and a Harness is generated output only. The rules also use the terms below, each defined once here; none of them is a `type`, a schema key or an ontology term. A mode is a way of using one Bundle: no mode adds a type, a key or a term, and a conformance claim names a Level (§10), never a mode. *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Mode 0** — the auto-wiki: Markdown items built into a site with a graph, search, the agent-facing text files and a discovery document, with no model anywhere (§6). The agent lane of AGSC-00-19 is optional in every mode. *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Mode 1** — distributed agentic memory: agents read a node through the local tool server or the page tools (§9) and change it only by Proposals that a person ratifies (§8); nodes federate on the client side (§11). *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Mode 2** — live specifications and engineering memory: Concepts of kind `principle`, `decision`, `spec`, `task` and `term`, with gates and episodes, joined by the five **Mode-2 Links** `implements`, `verifies`, `covers`, `blocked-by` and `decided-by` (AGSC-03-01), and read as boards in project mode (§10.5). *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Mode 3** — the evolving skills wiki: Procedures exported as one skill pack per cluster (§7.4), and lessons kept as the record of failures. *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Mode 4** — runnable knowledge: a composition of Concepts yields a Harness (§7). *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Mode 5** — the live board of AGSC-00-19 and §10.6. *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Persona** — one of the people and agents the requirements document describes, numbered P0 to P15 (`docs/PRD.md` §1). A rule that names a persona names a reader a node serves; it binds no persona. *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Forge** — the service that hosts the Bundle's git repository and runs its pull requests, rulesets and continuous integration. The reference distribution ships a forge shim for GitHub only (AGSC-08-12, AGSC-00-20). *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Content branch** — the branch of the Bundle's repository that a node is built and published from. Continuous integration never commits to it, except for the `channel:auto` merge of AGSC-08-26 (AGSC-08-02), and the tool server hands its changes to it as Proposals and never writes to it (AGSC-09-14b). *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Namespace document site** — the one origin that the w3id redirects of AGSC-06-06 resolve to, `https://agenticsystemcore.com/`. It serves this specification's vocabulary, JSON-LD context and schemas under `/ns/` and its pages under `/specs/`; a content node does not serve those routes (AGSC-06-01). *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Launch pipeline** — the `ci` and `review` lanes and everything they call; AGSC-08-27 keeps every model call out of it. *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **`refs[]`** — on an Episode (AGSC-02-14), an optional list of distinct `http:` or `https:` URLs of what the occurrence concerns, such as a pull request, an issue or a run log. It is kept as authored; it makes no Link, and no rule derives anything from it at 1.0. *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **Private names** — `urn:agsc:` (the source forms of AGSC-02-10 and AGSC-08-28) and `memory:` (the alias of AGSC-05-04…05-04b) are names private to this specification: the URN namespace `agsc` is not registered under RFC 8141 and the URI scheme `memory` is not registered under RFC 7595. Each is never dereferenced over a network and means only what the rule that uses it says. *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **NOW** is generated context, never an item and never hand-edited. *(AGSC-00-07)*
- **Card**, **page**, **deck** and **note** are UI or import vocabulary; they MUST NOT appear as a `type`, a schema key or an ontology term. *(AGSC-00-08)*
- **Agent lane** and **live board** complete the language for Mode 5. An **agent lane** is the OPTIONAL, configured capability by which a model-driven or programmatic agent creates, edits, reviews and updates items non-deterministically — always as Proposals, never as writes (AGSC-01-36, AGSC-08-28…30). A **live board** is a Bundle used as the shared working memory and pull-based task board of people and agents, local or remote: work is pulled by whoever claims a task, at most `max_claims` at a time, until the board is done (AGSC-10-16…18). The name says what it is — a board that is live, shared and always current; its operating discipline is Kanban's pull with a work-in-progress limit, and the blackboard architectural pattern (Hayes-Roth 1985, Nii 1986 — `docs/RELATED-WORK.md`) is its lineage. Neither adds a `type`, an item key or an ontology term; both are realised entirely with the objects §0.2 already names. *(AGSC-00-19)*
- **Declared scope by version.** The whole of this specification's scope is named here with the version at which each part becomes normative, so that a reader of any version sees the whole and a conforming tool never claims more than its version specifies. **1.0** (normative in this document): the Bundle and the six item types (§1, §2), the fourteen Links (§3), canonical forms (§4), the graph with the `memory://` alias and its resolution (§5, AGSC-05-04…05-04b), the surfaces (§6), composition and the Harness (§7), governance with the agent lane (§8), conformance (§9), Levels 0–3, project mode and Mode 5 (§10), the boundary with federation, the plugin contract, visibility, the declaration-only surfaces `solid` and `a2a-card`, the `responder` surface served by an MCP transport (AGSC-11-21), retirement and tombstones (§11). ## 2. The fourteen Link keys (AGSC-03-01)

`related` · `broader` · `narrower` · `uses` · `requires` · `excludes` · `derived-from` · `contradicts` · `supersedes` · `implements` · `verifies` · `covers` · `blocked-by` · `decided-by`

Of the core nine, `uses`, `requires`, `excludes`, `contradicts` and `supersedes` carry composition semantics (spec/03 §3.5); `related`, `broader`, `narrower` and `derived-from` never change a composition (AGSC-03-18), and the Mode-2 five (`implements`, `verifies`, `covers`, `blocked-by`, `decided-by`) are navigational and provenance edges. Inverses are computed, never authored (spec/03 §3.2).

## 3. Vocabulary terms (ontology/agsc.ttl, CC0)

| Term | Kind | Label | Domain → Range / Super-class | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `asc:Attachment` | Class | Attachment | ⊑ `prov:Entity` | A media file carried by an item under content/attachments/<slug>/ (AGSC-02-98); IRI <item-IRI>#attachment-<n> (AGSC-05-29). Pattern images are SVG only. |
| `asc:Bundle` | Class | Bundle | ⊑ `skos:ConceptScheme` | One directory tree of items published together; the concept scheme every Concept is in. |
| `asc:Cluster` | Class | Cluster | ⊑ `skos:Collection` | A navigational grouping of items. Membership is skos:member, authored on the item. Cluster nesting is also skos:member — never skos:broader, which would put a Collection in a semantic relation. |
| `asc:Concept` | Class | Concept | ⊑ `skos:Concept` | A unit of knowledge in a Bundle: a pattern, taxonomy, explainer, principle, decision, spec, task, term or architecture, distinguished by asc:kind. |
| `asc:Episode` | Class | Episode | ⊑ `prov:Activity` | A recorded occurrence — a session, run or incident — with a start, an actor and an outcome. |
| `asc:Gate` | Class | Gate | ⊑ `prov:Plan` | A declared set of checks that a change must pass; the verdict of a run is the file dist/gate.json that the ci verb writes (AGSC-08-10), not an item. |
| `asc:Harness` | Class | Harness | ⊑ `prov:Plan` | A generated bundle of files assembled from a validated composition of items; never authored, never stored under content/ (AGSC-07-12). |
| `asc:Lesson` | Class | Lesson | ⊑ `asc:Concept` | Knowledge drawn from experience, carrying a severity; a Concept by essence. It should name the Episode it comes from with derived-from (AGSC-02-16). |
| `asc:Procedure` | Class | Procedure | ⊑ `prov:Plan` | An executable-by-a-reader plan: trigger, steps and checks. Wrapped in the published skill pack of every Cluster it is a member of (AGSC-07-19), and rendered as its own SKILL.md in a Harness that selects it (AGSC-07-12). |
| `asc:Proposal` | Class | Proposal | ⊑ `prov:Activity` | A proposed change to a Bundle. It has no file: it is a forge pull request, and at 1.0 no triple instantiates it (AGSC-05-28). |
| `asc:Review` | Class | Review | ⊑ `prov:Activity` | The human assessment of a Proposal. It has no file: it is instantiated from a verified[] entry at the IRI <item-IRI>#review-<n>, its actor and instant carried by asc:verifiedBy and asc:verifiedAt (AGSC-05-15). |
| `asc:Source` | Class | Source | ⊑ `prov:Entity` | An external work cited by an item. It has no file: it is instantiated from a sources[] entry. |
| `asc:blockedBy` | ObjectProperty | blocked by | — → — | Mode-2 key 13: the subject cannot proceed until the object is resolved. No domain, range or super-property is declared. Combiner semantics: none. |
| `asc:blocks` | ObjectProperty | blocks | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:blockedBy; never authored. |
| `asc:consumes` | DatatypeProperty | consumes | `asc:Concept` → `xsd:string` | A port type name this item consumes (AGSC-02-96, AGSC-05-30). |
| `asc:contradicts` | ObjectProperty | contradicts | — → — | Asserts that two items cannot both be true. A pair of them in the result of a composition is a warning (AGSC-E803), never a failure (AGSC-07-07). No domain or range is declared: any item type may author this key, and declaring asc:Concept would entail a Concept typing for Procedures, Episodes and Gates. |
| `asc:coveredBy` | ObjectProperty | covered by | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:covers; never authored. |
| `asc:covers` | ObjectProperty | covers | — → — | Mode-2 key 12: the subject covers the object (a test, a check or a document covering a requirement). Combiner semantics: none. |
| `asc:decidedBy` | ObjectProperty | decided by | — → — | Mode-2 key 14: the subject was settled by the object, a decision item. Combiner semantics: none. |
| `asc:decides` | ObjectProperty | decides | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:decidedBy; never authored. |
| `asc:excludes` | ObjectProperty | excludes | — → — | Asserts mutual exclusion. Evaluated after the requires closure; a surviving pair invalidates a composition. No domain or range is declared, for the reason given on asc:contradicts. |
| `asc:generatedAt` | DatatypeProperty | generated at | — → `xsd:dateTime` | Instant at which an item was generated, with an explicit UTC offset. |
| `asc:generatedBy` | DatatypeProperty | generated by | — → `xsd:string` | Actor string that generated an item: human:<id>, process:<id> or <producer>/<version>. |
| `asc:grade` | DatatypeProperty | grade | `asc:Source` → `xsd:string` | Evidence grade of a Source: primary, secondary or tertiary. |
| `asc:hasAttachment` | ObjectProperty | has attachment | — → `asc:Attachment` | Links an item to one of its attachments (AGSC-05-29). No domain: items share no superclass (AGSC-05-13). |
| `asc:implementedBy` | ObjectProperty | implemented by | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:implements; never authored. |
| `asc:implements` | ObjectProperty | implements | — → — | Mode-2 key 10: the subject realises the object (code or a procedure realising a spec). Combiner semantics: none. |
| `asc:isVerifiedBy` | ObjectProperty | is verified by | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:verifies; never authored. Distinct from the datatype property asc:verifiedBy (AGSC-05-15). |
| `asc:kind` | DatatypeProperty | kind | `asc:Concept` → `xsd:string` | Qualifier on a Concept: pattern, taxonomy, explainer, principle, decision, spec, task, term or architecture. |
| `asc:level` | DatatypeProperty | level | `asc:Gate` → `xsd:string` | Gate level: L1 (schema and links) or L2 (adds provenance, determinism and review). |
| `asc:mentions` | ObjectProperty | mentions | — → — | Untyped edge produced by an inline Markdown link between items. Not a Link key; it may not appear in frontmatter. |
| `asc:model` | DatatypeProperty | model | — → `xsd:string` | Model identifier recorded when an item's origin is ai-assisted or ai-generated. |
| `asc:operator` | DatatypeProperty | operator | — → `xsd:string` | Person accountable for an item, written human:<id>: the human running the agent that produced it, or its author (AGSC-02-07). |
| `asc:origin` | DatatypeProperty | origin | — → `xsd:string` | How an item came to exist: human, ai-assisted, ai-generated or imported. |
| `asc:outcome` | DatatypeProperty | outcome | `asc:Episode` → `xsd:string` | Result of an Episode: success, partial or failure. |
| `asc:peerOrigin` | ObjectProperty | peer origin | — → — | The Bundle IRI of the declared peer node under whose base a cited resource lives (AGSC-11-12). Emitted beside rdfs:seeAlso; takes part in no composition step. No range is declared: the object is a foreign node's Bundle IRI about which this node asserts no class (AGSC-05-23). |
| `asc:produces` | DatatypeProperty | produces | `asc:Concept` → `xsd:string` | A port type name this item produces (AGSC-02-96, AGSC-05-30); matched by exact equality in composition Step 5 (AGSC-07-23). |
| `asc:retiredAt` | DatatypeProperty | retired at | — → `xsd:dateTime` | The instant at which an item entered status retired (AGSC-11-22): modified, else date, by the midnight convention of AGSC-05-14, as xsd:dateTime. |
| `asc:review` | ObjectProperty | review | — → `asc:Review` | Connects an item to each asc:Review instantiated from its verified[] entries (AGSC-05-15), so a Review is reachable from its item without string-parsing a fragment IRI. No domain is declared, for the reason given on asc:contradicts (AGSC-05-13: no asc:Item superclass). |
| `asc:severity` | DatatypeProperty | severity | `asc:Lesson` → `xsd:string` | Weight of a Lesson: info, warn or block. |
| `asc:sha256` | DatatypeProperty | SHA-256 | `asc:Attachment` → `xsd:string` | Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the attachment bytes at build (AGSC-05-29). |
| `asc:source` | ObjectProperty | source | — → `asc:Source` | Connects an item to each asc:Source instantiated from its sources[] entries (AGSC-05-14), so a Source is reachable from its item without string-parsing a fragment IRI. No domain is declared, for the reason given on asc:contradicts (AGSC-05-13: no asc:Item superclass). |
| `asc:specVersion` | DatatypeProperty | spec version | `asc:Bundle` → `xsd:string` | Version of the AgenticSystemCore specification a Bundle declares. |
| `asc:staleAfter` | DatatypeProperty | stale after | — → `xsd:dateTime` | Absolute instant after which an item is stale. Staleness is a comparison, never a decay function. |
| `asc:status` | DatatypeProperty | status | — → `xsd:string` | Publication state of an item: draft, stable, deprecated or retired (AGSC-11-22). |
| `asc:taskState` | DatatypeProperty | task state | `asc:Concept` → `xsd:string` | One of the nine Agent2Agent 1.0 task states, verbatim (AGSC-02-99, AGSC-10-13). |
| `asc:usedBy` | ObjectProperty | used by | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:uses; never authored. No domain or range is declared, for the reason given on asc:contradicts. |
| `asc:uses` | ObjectProperty | uses | — → — | Soft dependency: the subject draws on the object. A composition warns when a used item is absent. No domain, range or super-property is declared: skos:related is a sub-property of skos:semanticRelation, whose domain and range are skos:Concept (S19/S20), so a super-property axiom would re-introduce the unintended Concept typing and the S37 contradiction for Clusters (AGSC-05-26a). |
| `asc:verifiedAt` | DatatypeProperty | verified at | `asc:Review` → `xsd:dateTime` | Instant at which a human recorded a Review, with an explicit UTC offset. |
| `asc:verifiedBy` | DatatypeProperty | verified by | `asc:Review` → `xsd:string` | Actor string of the human who recorded a Review. |
| `asc:verifiedOn` | DatatypeProperty | verified on | `asc:Source` → `xsd:dateTime` | Instant at which a Source was last checked to resolve; an authored YYYY-MM-DD date is rendered as that day's midnight UTC instant. xsd:date is not in the OWL 2 datatype map, so xsd:dateTime keeps the ontology inside OWL 2 RL (AGSC-05-14, AGSC-05-22). |
| `asc:verifies` | ObjectProperty | verifies | — → — | Mode-2 key 11: the subject checks that the object holds. Its computed inverse is asc:isVerifiedBy (the datatype property asc:verifiedBy carries a Review actor and is unrelated). Combiner semantics: none. |

## 4. Boundary vocabulary (spec/11)

- **Surface** — an agent-facing entry a node serves and declares: `llms-txt`, `chunks`, `mcp`, `webmcp`, `a2a-card`, `solid`, `responder` (AGSC-11-16).
- **Access class** — what a reader needs before invoking a surface: `none`, `consent`, `credential` (AGSC-11-16).
- **Visibility** — `public` or `restricted` (AGSC-11-20); the discovery document is readable at both.
- **Contribute mode** — `pr`, `channel` or `form` (AGSC-11-14): where a proposal from anyone goes.
- **Peer** — another node named by its canonical well-known URL (AGSC-11-06); checked mutually, never fetched at build.
- **Walk** — a client-side traversal of peers bounded by `hop_limit`, `fan_out` and `max_requests` (AGSC-11-10).
- **Origin marking** — every peer-derived result carries `trust: untrusted` and the peer Bundle IRI (AGSC-11-11).
- **Tombstone** — the state of a node that stopped publishing: a valid link set with `agsc-tombstone` (AGSC-11-23).
- **Retired** — an item status that keeps the IRI, the page, the per-item copies and the graph entry, and leaves the indexes, the agent text files, the chunks, the skill packs and every selection (AGSC-11-22, AGSC-00-05).
- **Plugin contract** — declare · pin · inherit · prove (AGSC-11-16…19).
